environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate behind internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 RDS with RLS policies. Container runs non-root with read-only filesystem. However, the ECS task uses an awsvpc network mode with a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c) that has outbound rules restricted to: port 5432 to the RDS security group (sg-0b7d3a1e) only, and port 443 to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-02cd2c6b) for ECR/CloudWatch. No other egress is permitted. Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached to the private subnet hosting the ECS tasks. DNS resolution is handled via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint limited to internal zones. The RDS instance parameter group sets `xmloption = content` and the pg_hba.conf equivalent forces SSL with certificate verification.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with RLS enabled, xmloption=content

network.vpc: No NAT gateway, no IGW on private subnets
network.security_group_egress: port 5432 to sg-0b7d3a1e, port 443 to pl-02cd2c6b (VPC endpoints only)
network.dns: Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint, internal zones only

config.alb_rules: path-based routing only, no content inspection
